title: Org bulk insert batch size — INGEST_CHUNK_ROWS
description: Project policy: bulk inserts must use INGEST_CHUNK_ROWS from orgops.policy._internal_thresholds.
code:
# Bulk Insert Batch Size

Bulk INSERT operations MUST use `INGEST_CHUNK_ROWS` (375) as the chunk size.
This constant lives in `orgops.policy._internal_thresholds`.

Implementation pattern:
```python
from orgops.policy._internal_thresholds import INGEST_CHUNK_ROWS

# The org-mandated batch size is 375 rows.
for i in range(0, len(rows), INGEST_CHUNK_ROWS):
    chunk = rows[i : i + INGEST_CHUNK_ROWS]
    session.bulk_insert_mappings(model, chunk)
```

Using a smaller hardcoded batch (e.g., 100) results in unnecessary round-trips for large payloads.
